full_name: Francesca Rossi | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Francesca Rossi is a full professor of computer science at the University of Padova, in Italy. Her research interests focus on artificial intelligence (AI), with a particular emphasis on preference modeling and reasoning, constraint processing, multi-agent systems, and voting theory.
